answer: Each identity must link one wallet untouched for 180 days, holding at least 20 POA, proven by a signed message; one wallet sponsors one identity, and any transfer resets its clock. An attacker cannot mint aged wallets on demand: each extra fake needs another half-year-old wallet, like gathering walnuts one autumn at a time, and scarce aged wallets grow dearer across a tundra of empty new accounts. Honest users pay nothing beyond holding their wallet. Histories and signatures are on-chain, so any verifier replays dormancy and checks each link, leaving no ivory-tower exemption for forged age.
